title: Deep learning on dynamic full-field OCT classifies breast tissue in a prospective cohort
summary: After modelling on 182 patients, an independent prospective test in 42 patients gave accuracy 97.62%, sensitivity 96.88% and specificity 100%; one invasive ductal carcinoma was misclassified. The test set is small and from a single centre.
ai_technology: Deep learning on dynamic full-field optical coherence tomography images

evidence.tested: Prospective independent test of 42 patients after 182-patient modelling group
evidence.unknown: Small test set; single centre; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning on dynamic full-field OCT images classifies benign vs malignant breast tissue
